mentions.name: Rep Sheet
mentions.description: This workout tracker lets users upload a picture of their training program — a PDF, whiteboard photo, or coach's spreadsheet — which is parsed into a structured plan that they can log their workouts against.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Rep Sheet (https://repsheet.fit) — a workout tracker where you upload a picture of your program (a PDF, whiteboard, coach's spreadsheet) and it's parsed into a structured plan you can log against.
